arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS localization_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS printing_count,
       COUNT(f.text) AS populated_texts,
       SUM(TRIM(f.text) = '') AS blank_texts
FROM sets AS s
JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND f.language = 'Italian';
